        21       Mr. President.  Very briefly.

        22                  I want to point out to those here

        24       important to the City of New York and the

        25       State of New York.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

         1                  The total amount of revenue lost

         2       annually as a result of piracy is in excess of

         3       $20 billion, much of that in the State of

         4       New York, where the motion picture industry

         5       has grown significantly, contributing not only

         6       jobs but income at all levels -- not just in

         7       the theaters, not just in the studios, but in

         8       a whole myriad of areas that produce revenues

         9       that we need to function properly.

        10                  And piracy has been a way of

        11       avoiding that income on the part of those who

        12       capitalize on this activity.

        13                  For the last two sessions we passed

        14       a bill sponsored by Senator Volker that did

        15       very much of what this bill today does.  Now

        16       we have the imprimatur of the Attorney General

        17       Andrew Cuomo, who has gotten behind this in a

        18       very significant way, and I'm hopeful that

        19       we'll pass this bill now in both houses and

        20       make it law.

        21                  I vote aye.
